user.title: Connect to a Vantiva gateway
user.description: Enter the address and web interface credentials of the gateway.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the gateway, for example 192.168.1.254. A scheme (http:// or https://) and port are accepted.
data_description.username: Web interface user name, usually admin.
data_description.password: Web interface password, often printed on the gateway label.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the gateway
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {host} rejected the stored password. Enter the current web interface password.

error.locked_out: The gateway has temporarily locked the account after failed logins. Wait {wait} seconds and try again.

abort.wrong_device: The address now points to a different gateway. Remove this entry and add the new gateway instead.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls of the gateway (minimum 10).
data_description.consider_home: Seconds a client stays home after the gateway stops reporting it as active.

invalid_auth.message: The gateway rejected the stored credentials.

locked_out.message: The gateway account is temporarily locked (wait {wait} seconds).
